children: LifeMD announced an exclusive collaboration with AT&T to provide eligible AT&T wireless and fiber customers a complimentary LifeMD membership valued at $228 per year.
More than 100 million eligible AT&T customers receive complimentary LifeMD membership, expanding virtual care reach.
Initial rollout covers 29 million customers in 11 states, with nationwide expansion planned January 2027.
LifeMD will pay AT&T a fixed fee per lead initially; later compensation will be negotiated between the parties.
Agreement term is one year with automatic one-year renewals unless 90 days' notice is given; joint steering committee to govern the program.
Members keep paying for visits, prescriptions and services (membership fee waived); visit and pricing details provided in the program FAQ.

title: AT&T and LifeMD strike exclusive deal to offer free $228/year virtual care to 100M+ customers
